name: Maple Infrastructure Trust
summary: Maple Infrastructure Trust, operates as a road infrastructure platform in India. The company focuses on ownership and management of highway assets. Its portfolio includes Shree Jagannath Expressways, NCR Eastern Peripheral Expressway, Sambalpur-Baragarh, Durg, Bhandara, Dankuni-Kharagpur, and Belgaum-Dharwad. The company was formerly known as Indian Highway Concessions Trust and changed its name to Maple Infrastructure Trust in November 2024. Maple Infrastructure Trust was founded in 2019 and is based in Mumbai, India.
